title: Sunday · the Rain, 2007
logline: Tenth January. The first Rain with forty thousand readers. The strip draws it exactly as it drew it for three hundred.

panels.composition: Tier 1: the beach in rain. Controlled watercolor. No figures this year.

image.prompt: a Pacific Northwest beach in January rain in controlled gray and sea-green watercolor, no figures, no words

panels.name: Veil

panels.composition: Tier 2: the spruce grove. Nobody at its foot.

image.prompt: a dark spruce grove in rain, watercolor, empty, no words

panels.name: Grove

panels.composition: Tier 3: the beach, later, the rain thinning, and two sets of prints in the wet sand going up it — a man's and a dog's — but not the man or the dog.

image.prompt: a rainy beach with the rain thinning and two sets of tracks in the wet sand, a man's and a dog's, leading away, no figures, watercolor, no words
image.notes: The first Rain with an audience. The strip removes itself and leaves tracks.

panels.name: Tracks

art.line: brush-pen scanned; muddy digital flats; Sundays in watercolor, improving
art.palette: limited, muddy; Sundays gray-green, rust, one warm

notes: Forty thousand readers get the Rain with nobody in it.
